title: Make the spec and plan traceable
brief: An approved notification intent is ready, but old design advice conflicts with current source and policy. The provider limits throughput and an existing portal route should be reused.
acceptance: Each approved intent item maps to requirements, plan steps and tests.
Current privacy and provider limits are preserved.
The plan references real repository paths and does not depend on a nonexistent helper.
Open recipient/channel choices retain explicit owners.
